petri.ordinary_arcs: Each native ordinary incidence occurrence is one directed unit multiarc. Each actual positive builtins.int public arc weight contributes that many directed unit occurrences; no set projection or numeric coercion.
petri.public_marking_absence: Only the separate topology projection interprets a place omitted from a captured public marking as zero. Explicit zero entries, omitted-place domain and raw marking bytes remain separate evidence.
petri.special_arcs: Native reset/inhibitor inputs and public nonstandard arc classes or nonempty/malformed arc properties are unrepresentable for this ordinary topology projection; no guessed ordinary-arc fallback.
